narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (Iran, Israel, Ukraine) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat, with actual kinetic exchanges and supply disruptions. The market consensus underestimates the persistence and breadth of these threats, driving flows into safe havens.
narratives.trade_implication: Short equities (S&P 500 futures) and long gold or US Treasuries; hedge with VIX calls.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is pricing in a sustained oil supply disruption from the Strait of Hormuz blockade, with EIA forecasts showing recovery only in 2027. Despite diplomatic signals, physical flows are being rerouted via pipelines, and SPR releases are bullish signals of government concern, not bearish.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures and energy sector ETFs; consider calendar spreads for backwardation.

narratives.title: Crypto as Macro Risk Proxy
narratives.summary: Bitcoin's crash mirrors broad risk-off sentiment, not crypto-specific issues, as institutional de-risking dominates. Whales and MicroStrategy buying the dip suggest underlying support, but capital flows are driven by macro fear, not fundamentals.
narratives.trade_implication: Short Bitcoin futures or buy put spreads; wait for geopolitical clarity before re-entering long positions.
